'''Dev''' was a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] and a member of [[Yayax Squad]], who was born on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] and trained by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Rav Bralor]]. He participated in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] and later defected from the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and traveled to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]] along with the rest of Yayax Squad.
